title: The Comrades Marathon: a narrative review of physiological responses and health implications in the world's oldest ultra-marathon
claims: The review estimates about 1,800–1,900 m of total ascent and about 1,200 m of descent on the Up Run, and about 1,200 m of ascent and 1,800–1,900 m of descent on the Down Run.
Route lengths vary from 86 to 92 km depending on the finish venue.

Exercise-associated hyponatremia was uncommon at Comrades, below 2%, while hypernatremia was substantially more prevalent; dehydration was the most common diagnosis at 7.5% and exercise-associated muscle cramping at 3.2%.
Medical encounters occurred at rates up to 20 per 1,000 starters, with the fluid/electrolyte system the most affected at 8.8%.
The review synthesises 42 publications specifically focused on the Comrades Marathon, published up to December 2025.
The time limit for the approximately 90 km course is 12 hours.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取 Frontiers in Physiology 2026 综述 PDF，抄录 Up/Down Run 升降估计、86–92 km 区间、EAH <2%、脱水 7.5%、医疗接触率与 42 篇文献范围。
